text:
Elena: quick design review - noticed a11y weirdness with icon-only actions in compact table rows (copy, pin, more). focus ring gets clipped when density token is 6px. can we audit?
Mike: saw that too. repro steps? which table variant?
Elena: console -> deployments table, compact density, rows at 36px height. when you tab to the copy icon the ring sits half-off the row.
Tara: might be a combination of negative margin on the icon button and overflow:hidden on the row. CSS snippet from prod: `tr.row { overflow: hidden; } .icon-btn { margin: -4px; }`
Josh: not sure we should rely on negative margins for alignment. could we use padding or change focus outline to inset? inset rings feel less discoverable imo.
Aria: accessibility priority = visible focus + no layout shift. my vote: keep outline outside but ensure overflow allows it. probably update density token mapping so container padding >= focus halo.
Mike: proposed quick fix: .table-row { overflow: visible; } but that can break clipping for other elements (dropdowns).
Tara: alternate: add 2px extra focus-offset to the button and use box-shadow on focus instead of outline. example: `button:focus { box-shadow: 0 0 0 3px var(--focus); }`
DesignBot: Automations: linked design token change request #DT-482.
Elena: we should consider two approaches and test across breakpoints: 1) increase row padding (density token change) 2) keep padding but alter focus presentation for icon-only. both have tradeoffs for vertical rhythm.
Josh: mock here: https://www.figma.com/file/xyz/compact-tables?node-id=204%3A12 (updated frame) — note the copy icon gets 3px halo and the pin uses a subtle halo to avoid overlap with action menu.
Aria: copy action also needs accessible label change — currently `aria-label="copy"` which is too generic in table context. suggest `aria-label="Copy deployment id"` or include row context.
Mike: agreed. add it to the copy handler: `aria-label={`Copy ${deployment.name} id`}`. also consider title tooltip left aligned so it won't overflow the edge.
Tara: small nit re: keyboard order — after adding more spacing, confirm tab order remains icon1 -> icon2 -> menu, not jumping into row selection.
Elena: validation plan: 1) visual QA in 3 density tokens (compact, default, spacious) 2) keyboard-only walkthrough 3) voiceover check for aria-labels 4) perf smoke to ensure no layout thrash
Josh: timeline? can we get a patch on dev by EOD Friday?
Tara: can do a PR with the box-shadow focus change + aria-labels. will flag potential regressions in the PR description.
DesignBot: PR created: #2345 by Tara — includes screenshots and before/after.
Aria: one more UX ask — for copy action show a transient inline toast near the icon instead of global toast so it's obvious which row copied. short: "Copied" with subtle check icon. avoids confusing when multiple toasts happen.
Mike: inline toast + a11y alert region. add `role="status" aria-live="polite"` on the row for screen readers.
Elena: love it. ok next steps: Tara -> implement focus halo + aria-labels + inline toast. Josh -> update figma with exact halo color and spacing tokens. Mike -> QA keyboard + screenreader. I'll follow up on density token impacts and open token MR if needed.
Tara: working on PR today, will ping here when ready for review. :rocket:
Josh: thanks! :thumbsup:
DesignBot: Reminder: design review sync tomorrow 10am.
Elena: thanks all.
